mapper.select: SELECT ac.content FROM ap_article_content ac INNER JOIN ap_article a ON ac.article_id = a.id WHERE ac.content IS NOT NULL AND ac.content != '' AND (a.is_deleted = 0 OR a.is_deleted IS NULL)
SELECT image_urls FROM ap_pins WHERE image_urls IS NOT NULL AND image_urls != '' AND created_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
